data.title: Dar-E-Nijaat
data.description:
Some stories begin with love.
Some are tested by loss.
And some are remembered for the courage it takes to forgive.
Written By: Umera Ahmed
Directed By: Saqib Khan

data.title: LAGAN LAGI
data.description:
Was it just a dream… or a warning of what’s to come?
When fear feels real and the lines between dreams and reality begin to blur, what awaits on the other side?

data.title: Izzat
data.description:
They have the love everyone dreams of… but will it always be this perfect?
A story of choices that could put everything to the test.

data.title: Hey Fam
data.description:
The wait is over. It’s time for the grand reveal of Seerat, the name destined to become a social media sensation.
Get ready to meet the girl everyone is talking about.
Written By: Awais Ahmad Joiya
DIrected By: Zeshan Ansari

data.title: Mera Ghar
data.description:
Some dreams begin with hope, while others carry the shadows of an untold past.
Mera Ghar - A story of love, fate, and secrets that refuse to stay hidden.

data.title: Rutba
data.description:
A relationship built on respect. A bond meant to be protected.
But what happens when the very person meant to honour it begins to forget its worth?
Written By: Umera Ahmed
Directed By: Haseeb Hassan

data.title: Jeeto Pakistan
data.description: Jeeto Pakistan is one of the most popular game shows in Pakistan, hosted by the charismatic Fahad Mustafa. The show features a variety of fun and engaging games, where participants from the live audience get the chance to win exciting prizes, ranging from household items to cars. Jeeto Pakistan also has special segments and guest appearances by celebrities, making it a thrilling and entertaining experience for viewers

data.title: Good Morning Pakistan
data.description: Good Morning Pakistan is your first source of entertainment as soon as you wake up in the morning, keeping you energized for the rest of the day.
